Name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds a new weather and machine that makes food rain.

The weather has 4 variations, one for each season with different types of food.

To get the recipe you must finish Maru's quest for the lost prototype.

Spoilers!
How to get the quest?
[spoiler]
Must have 5 hearts with Maru
Minimum year is 2
Read Maru's mail
[/spoiler]
Where is the prototype?
[spoiler]
Behind the community center, in the pink tree.
[/spoiler]
